text: Merge the overlapping idea notes: status comment, reflection, and connection hypothesis/evaluation

status.comment: Proposal for Felix: keep the edge hypothesis/evaluation (it is per edge; an idea with two parents has two different reasons, which no idea-level field can hold). Fold the free-text reflection into the status comment (evidence belongs to the state it justifies; git keeps earlier comments). Also drop reflections[]? Lessons are what /dream consolidates, so they could live only in dream reflections on the root. Needs a migration either way. Agree, or keep reflections[]?

description: Felix 2026-10-16: status, reflection and the connection hypothesis overlap; maybe only status and connection reflection are needed. Today an idea has four text notes: status.comment, reflection (free text), reflections[] (structured lessons), and per parent edge hypothesis + evaluation.
